title: Umbrella Generator Schema
description: Adds an umbrella chart that bundles chart projects of this workspace as file:// subcharts, so one helm install deploys them together.

name.description: Name of the umbrella chart. Converted to a valid Kubernetes name, like the chart generator does.
name.x-prompt: Provide a name for the umbrella chart

charts.x-prompt: Which chart projects should the umbrella chart bundle (comma-separated)?

directory.description: Folder for the umbrella chart, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to `charts/{name}`.

publishSubcharts.description: Keep publishing the bundled charts on their own with nx release publish. With false, only the umbrella is published, with the subcharts inside it.
